premises.text: People stick to familiar places because they will not risk new venues without trusted certainty they will like them
premises.evidence_span: we don't want to take the chance and try to go to a new place because we're not sure that we're going to like the experience

premises.text: SpotOn personalizes place recommendations from Facebook/Foursquare and in-app ratings, with friend social proof and who-to-go-with
premises.evidence_span: pulling in your existing social network data from Facebook and Foursquare, uses it to build a profile of you to give you personalized and actionable recommendations

premises.text: Map, picture, filter, bookmark, and search surfaces make choosing a place fast so users spend time enjoying places with friends
premises.evidence_span: We do not want you to spend a lot of time wasting, trying to figure out where to go

value.text: Easiest way to go to new places with friends and enjoy the end experience together
value.evidence_span: the easiest way to go to new places with your friends

causal_links.evidence_span: end up at that same old coffee shop

notes: Friend ratings/who-to-go-with/rating game/filters/search folded as cascade of one social recommendation product (§4.1.7). Group-recommendation and in-app planning pipeline treated as near-future roadmap, not separate premises (§4.1.4).
